messages:
From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff — scope, security checklist, and access next steps (Lumenix)

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to align. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before the kickoff session next Wednesday (2026-08-12). Please reply with any clarifications or corrections.

Summary of pain & goals
- Primary pain: long lead times and low-precision automated responses in customer support triage (high-cost human touches for refunds/escalations).
- Goal: reduce human-handled triage by 40% within 60 days while keeping escalation precision >= 95%.

Proposed pilot scope (30 days)
- Workload: support triage + canned reply suggestion for 3 product lines (billing, onboarding, technical).
- Model variant: Redwood-managed open model (quantized variant) served in Dedicated pool; temporary fallback to hosted small model for spikes.
- Success metrics: triage automation rate, escalation precision, average end-to-end latency (target p95 < 350ms), cost per 1k messages.

Prompt set & evals
- Deliverable: 150 prompt/email examples across the 3 product lines + 30 edge-case prompts for safety/regression checks.
- We will run a blind eval (A/B) comparing current ruleset vs Redwood outputs on the prompt set.

Owners & timeline
- Lumenix: Jacob (POC) — label mapping, sample messages, Slack access.
- Redwood: Aditya — overall PM; Marissa — implementation & evals; Ben — infra/access and quantization profile.
- Kickoff workshop (operational): 2026-08-12 09:00–10:30 PT — invite sent.
- Pilot window: 2026-08-13 to 2026-09-12 (30 days). Checkpoint cadence: weekly sync (Fridays).

Access / security asks (what we need from Lumenix before kickoff)
1) Short-term: SFTP drop or secure Share (S3 presigned link) for sample training/eval data (no PII preferred).
2) Network: allow outbound to redwood-inference-{region}.redwood.ai IP range; we'll provide the exact CIDR by EOD.
3) Auth: service account key for access to your test tenant (scoped read-only) or short-lived AWS role.
4) Compliance: completed security questionnaire (I'll attach a draft SOW now).

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (draft scope & timeline).

Next steps (action items)
- Jacob: share sample data + account mapping by Tue 2026-08-11 EOD.
- Lumenix security: share completed questionnaire and any blocking controls by Tue 2026-08-11.
- Redwood: circulate final kickoff agenda and technical runbook by Tue 2026-08-11.

If this looks good I’ll lock the kickoff and create the HubSpot milestone for the pilot start.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Aditya / team — we completed the first pass of the questionnaire. Highlights / blockers: 
- Data residency: test data can be in us-west-2, but production requires EU region for EU customers. Pilot okay in US.
- KMS: we require customer-managed keys (CMK) for any dataset that could include PII. Can Redwood accept an external KMS/HSM or will you use your KMS?
- Retention: logs that contain request/response payloads must be configurable to 30/90/365 days. Does Redwood support configurable retention per deployment?

Please respond to the three items above. If needed we can jump on a 30-minute call tomorrow.

Regards,
Lumenix Security Team
sec@lumenix.com

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the security notes — short answers below and happy to get on a 30-min call Wed if that helps.

1) KMS: For the Dedicated pilot we support customer-managed keys via an external KMS integration (we have a standard KMIP bridge for supported HSMs and can accept AWS CMKs for S3 access). I’ll loop in Ben for technical details and an integration runbook.
2) Retention: Redwood supports configurable retention windows at deployment level (30/90/365) and can mask logs containing PII on ingestion. Configuration will be part of the pilot runbook.
3) Data residency: pilot in us-west-2 is OK; we'll document EU deployment options for later.

Action items updated:
- Ben: share KMS integration checklist & CIDRs by EOD Tuesday (2026-08-17).
- Jacob: upload initial sample set to the S3 presigned link by 2026-08-11 (per Maya).
- Aditya/Marissa: finalize kickoff agenda and send invites for 2026-08-12 workshop.

If everyone is aligned I’ll mark the HubSpot milestone to "Ready for Kickoff" and prepare the runbook.

Best,
Aditya
